payload.body_you: {{holder1}} says something that upsets you, then starts explaining what they meant. The more {{holder1}} explains, the more you feel like the actual problem is disappearing. You want them to understand why it bothered you before the conversation becomes a defense of their intention.
payload.body_they: Something you say upsets {{holder1}}, and your first instinct may be to explain what you meant. {{holder1}} is still trying to tell you why it bothered them. The two of you can end up having completely different conversations at the same time.
